summary.text: David Sheppard is the Republican candidate for the Illinois House of Representatives, District 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Democrat Rick Ryan.
A retired law enforcement officer and Navy veteran, he ran for the same seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: David Sheppard was born in Chicago, Illinois, has experience serving in the U.S. Navy, and has a career background as a chief of police, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father, elected school board member, small business owner and retired law enforcement officer.
Sheppard lost the November 8, 2022 general election for District 36 to incumbent Kelly M. Burke, receiving 38.2 percent of the vote.
He advanced from the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.
His 2026 survey lists as priorities children with disabilities, capping property taxes and local levies, and policy affecting seniors, teachers, homeowners and small business owners.
